content.text: Section 22 fully covers the preferred position, and Section 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) contains only a heading with no substantive text, so no wider audit right exists.

input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22.1 caps audits at once per twelve-month period, requires thirty days' prior written notice, limits audits to normal business hours, mandates off-site conduct where practicable, and requires an independent auditor bound by confidentiality. Section 22.2 places audit costs on Vendor unless underpayment exceeds five percent and expressly bars Vendor and its auditor from direct access to Customer systems, Customer Data unrelated to usage, privileged material, or another supplier's confidential information. Section 22.3 further protects us by making findings Customer Confidential Information and limiting their use. Section 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) contains only a heading with no operative text, and no other clause creates an inspection or verification right binding Customer. This matches the preferred position in full; no redline needed.
